title: J2 power-law symbolic model
objective: Implement symbolic yield function, power-law hardening law, return mapping scaffolding, and algorithmic tangent output form for J2 plasticity.
implementation_steps: Implement yield function: f = sigma_eq - sigma_y(alpha) where sigma_y = sigma_y0 + K*alpha^n
Implement power-law hardening law: sigma_y(alpha) = sigma_y0 + K*alpha^n
Implement return mapping scaffolding (symbolic predictor-corrector structure)
Implement algorithmic tangent output form (elastic/plastic branches)
Write tests for elastic/plastic branch selection and consistency
acceptance_criteria: Yield function correctly identifies elastic vs plastic regime
Hardening law: sigma_y increases monotonically with alpha
Consistency: yield function = 0 at converged plastic state

cases: Return mapping consistency: f(sigma_trial - delta_lambda * n) = 0

risks: Symbolic return mapping may be complex — keep as scaffolding, numerical implementation in P8.1
Von Mises near-zero handling per 07-CONVENTIONS.md: sigma_eq < 1e-12*sigma_y
